note: WAEC Economics round 6 (R33 top-up): histogram bars touching and the median of four values; taste shifting demand; ceteris paribus; the good's own price moving along supply; elasticity of supply; land's vertical supply; the break-even point; farming as Nigeria's biggest occupation; positive net migration; population density; vital registration; near money; real wage; tax incidence; a fine is no tax; per capita income hiding inequality; current against capital account; a stronger naira cheapening imports; the customs union's common tariff; trade surplus; the vicious circle; capital flight; diversification; the indigenisation decrees; globalisation; the multinational; crowding out; the circular flow; leakages; the multiplier; the business cycle; the recession; the informal sector. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-5, NECO Economics (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
